title: Intel Corporation to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conference
gist: Intel announced CFO David Zinsner and IR VP John Pitzer will hold a fireside chat on Intel's business and strategy at Deutsche Bank's 2026 Technology Conference on August 26, publicly webcast via Intel IR.

insights.claim: Intel CFO David Zinsner and corporate VP of global treasury and investor relations John Pitzer will participate in a fireside chat on Intel's business and strategy at Deutsche Bank's 2026 Technology Conference on August 26 at 10:35 a.m. PDT.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Watch for strategy or turnaround commentary that could move INTC.

insights.claim: A live webcast and replay of Intel's fireside chat will be publicly accessible on Intel's Investor Relations website at intc.com.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Accessible signal source for investors tracking Intel strategy.

insights.claim: Intel describes itself as a company that designs and manufactures advanced semiconductors that connect and power the modern world.
insights.speaker: SemiWiki
insights.so_what: Boilerplate positioning; no new operational data.
